about: The presence detector's ONNX models, pinned by sha256 (camera_presence.verify_model refuses other bytes). The files are NOT committed (this repository is public): they are the panel presence study's exports of 2026-09-15 (HomeHub METHOD_PRESENCE_BODY_CLASSIFIER_2026-09-15.md sections 4 and 11; yolov8n_448 and yolov8n_640, the couch check's larger inputs of the same family, from the same export, measured offline 2026-11-11), kept in the operator's model bundle beside the panel's sensor models. faceyolo is a single-class YOLOv8n face detector; yolov8n is the COCO detector (class 0, person). install-presence-runtime.sh copies them to /opt/homehub-presence/models.
